О проекте

The Residences at InterContinental Phuket Resort is a 111-unit branded condominium built next to the InterContinental resort in Kamala. It is the second residential project between Proud Real Estate and IHG, after InterContinental Residences Hua Hin, and is designed by Habita Architects, the studio that designed the resort itself. The project value is about THB 2.5 billion.

The seven-storey building offers fully furnished homes from one-bedroom suites to large penthouses; units currently advertised are one- and two-bedroom apartments of about 59 to 101 sqm. Residents have the resort's services and facilities, including its spa, restaurants and beach bar, plus their own pool, gym, library, games room and about 2,000 sqm of gardens. The developer is pursuing Fitwel certification, with solar panels and grey-water recycling.

Kamala Beach is beside the resort and Phuket FantaSea about 2.4 km away. Completion is planned for September 2027.

  • Статус строительства: предпродажа; срок завершения: сентябрь 2027.
  • Заявленная стартовая цена: 13 600 000 ฿.
  • Рядом, по данным проекта: Пляж Камала (beside the resort).
